clue.text: Deregistered vehicle on Square in motion

indicators.note: on signals that one piece is placed next to the other in the answer

parts.note: S stands for square, as in an address abbreviation for a town square
a truck is a goods vehicle
off means started and moving, as in 'they're off' at a race

explanation.surface: A car taken off the register is still being driven round a town square.
explanation.definitionFit: A doctor or lawyer removed from the professional register has been struck off it.

clue.text: Small teams alternately used in place of trials

indicators.note: alternately means taking every other letter, starting with the first

explanation.surface: Smaller sides are rotated in at the venue for team tryouts.
explanation.definitionFit: The Massachusetts town was the site of the notorious witch trials of 1692.

clue.text: Competition forced Larry to box drip

indicators.note: boxing something means enclosing it
forced suggests the letters are pushed out of shape and rearranged

parts.note: an IV drip is an intravenous drip

explanation.surface: In a contest, Larry is made to fight a weakling.
explanation.walkthrough: 'drip' looks like a feeble person, but it is the hospital IV.
explanation.definitionFit: Rivalry is competition between parties striving for the same thing.

clue.text: Awful lyrics Elton originally put on record

indicators.note: put on means one piece is placed beside the other

parts.note: chronic is informal British for very bad

indicators.note: originally means the first letter of each word is taken

explanation.surface: Terrible lyrics that Elton John first released on a record.
explanation.definitionFit: A chronicle is a written account of events in order.

clue.text: Remarkable trip nurses endure

indicators.note: nursing something means holding it close inside

parts.note: an outing is a trip
to stand something is to endure it

explanation.surface: A remarkable outing that the nursing staff had to put up with.
explanation.definitionFit: Exceptional, standing out from the rest.

clue.text: Litter in seats most distant from us

definitions.meaning: split in two, the clue words describe the back line of seating, the one farthest away

explanation.surface: Litter is scattered in the seats at the back.
explanation.definitionFit: A farrow is a litter of pigs; read as two words it is the back line of seats.

clue.text: Tailless bird outside of innyard in need of pluck

indicators.note: an animal without its tail loses its end, so the last letter of the word goes

parts.note: doing bird is British slang for serving time in prison

indicators.note: the outside of a word is its first and last letters

explanation.surface: A bird with no tail stands outside a pub's yard, needing courage.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bird' is not a feathered creature but prison slang for a sentence, TIME; 'Tailless' cuts it to TIM.
explanation.definitionFit: Pluck is courage, so someone lacking it is shy and fearful.

clue.text: Characters seized by capturing city

indicators.note: seized by means held within the letters of the next word

explanation.surface: Characters are seized when an army takes a city.
explanation.definitionFit: The Piedmontese capital in northern Italy.

clue.text: Bit of a well-known Indian spice missing at home

parts.note: Narendra Modi is the Prime Minister of India

indicators.note: missing means a part is taken away

parts.note: cumin is a spice used in curries
in means at home

explanation.surface: A famous Indian dish is short of a spice at home.
explanation.definitionFit: A small quantity of something, a little.

clue.text: Circle Line finally to progress, the Board is shown

parts.note: a disc is a circle

indicators.note: finally means the last letter of each of the following words

explanation.surface: The transport board reveals whether London's Circle Line will finally get going.
explanation.walkthrough: The Circle Line is a London Underground line.
explanation.definitionFit: Something revealed or made known has been shown.

clue.text: Seesaw maybe starts to entertain the youngster

parts.note: a seesaw is an example of a lever, a beam on a pivot

indicators.note: starts to means the opening letters of the following words are taken

explanation.surface: A seesaw in a playground is the toy to keep a child happy.
explanation.definitionFit: A young hare is called by this name, so it fits a youngster of that animal.

clue.text: Screen some episode re-runs making a comeback

indicators.note: coming back means the letters are taken in the opposite direction
some of the words means only part of their letters is used

explanation.surface: A television screen shows repeats of an old episode.
explanation.walkthrough: 'some' picks a run of letters from 'episode re-runs', and 'making a comeback' reads that run backwards.
explanation.definitionFit: This is an ornamental screen standing behind a church altar.

clue.text: Note left the heart of Scandi fashion capital

parts.note: mi is the third note of the sol-fa scale

indicators.note: the heart of a word is its central letters

explanation.surface: A fashion writer notes that the leading capital has abandoned Scandinavian style.
explanation.definitionFit: The Italian city is one of the world's great centres of the clothing industry.

clue.text: Criminal can't lie to protect child specialist

indicators.note: protecting something means wrapping around it
criminal suggests the letters have been treated wrongly and so rearranged

explanation.surface: A criminal who cannot lie shields a child from a specialist investigator.
explanation.definitionFit: Specialist and technical both describe language or knowledge belonging to an expert field.

clue.text: The current Mrs J grabs recycled items offered at tills

parts.note: Carrie Johnson was then the wife of Prime Minister Boris Johnson

indicators.note: recycled means put through again into a new form, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: The Prime Minister's wife picks up recycled goods at the checkout.
explanation.definitionFit: Shops offer plastic sacks for shopping at the checkout.

clue.text: Arranged home for the Trotters (Del retired)

parts.note: pigs, which have trotters, live in a sty; the Trotters are also the family in the British sitcom Only Fools and Horses

indicators.note: retired means going back, so the word is read backwards

parts.note: Del is Del Boy, the lead character of the Trotter family

explanation.surface: The Trotter family's home was set out neatly after Del Boy retired.
explanation.walkthrough: Only Fools and Horses is a British sitcom about the Trotter family, whose best-known member is Del Boy; trotters are also pigs' feet.
explanation.definitionFit: Hair or a room that has been arranged has been given a particular look or design.

clue.text: Questioning infected mobster full of cold

indicators.note: full of means holding something inside

parts.note: septic means infected
Al Capone was a famous mobster

explanation.surface: A gangster with an infected wound and a cold is doubtful.
explanation.definitionFit: Doubtful, not easily convinced.

clue.text: Barney books into centre with secretarial staff?

indicators.note: into means one piece goes inside another

parts.note: core means centre
NT is the New Testament, a set of books of the Bible
temps are temporary office workers, often secretaries

explanation.surface: An office row breaks out over books in the centre and the agency typists.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Barney' is British slang for a noisy quarrel, not a name.
explanation.definitionFit: An unexpected mishap or minor squabble, from the French for an awkward moment.

clue.text: Spin endless claptrap after match

indicators.note: after means this piece comes behind the other

parts.note: a Test is an international cricket match

indicators.note: endless means the final letter is removed

parts.note: drivel is nonsense

explanation.surface: Endless political spin follows the cricket Test match.
explanation.definitionFit: A spin is a short drive in a car, here to try it out before buying.

clue.text: Old-timer shakily draws what might be digits

parts.note: ex means former, as in an ex-husband

indicators.note: shakily suggests unsteady movement, so the letters are jumbled

parts.note: ties are drawn games

explanation.surface: An elderly man draws something with a trembling hand.
explanation.definitionFit: Fingers and toes are digits, and they are the body's outermost parts.

clue.text: Proposition from Oscar splitting the band

indicators.note: splitting means going inside and dividing

parts.note: R.E.M. is an American rock band
O is Oscar in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: An Oscar win breaks up the band.
explanation.definitionFit: A mathematical statement to be proved.

clue.text: See 14 across
Pain in bum possibly accepted by most of city

indicators.note: accepted by means taken inside
most of means all but the last letter

parts.note: Lagos is the largest city in Nigeria

indicators.note: possibly suggests the letters could be arranged another way

explanation.surface: A pain in the backside is felt in most parts of the city.
explanation.definitionFit: The word names a specific ache in the lower back, so pain is a broader term for it.

clue.text: In Paris to swim with pretty youth

indicators.note: with means one piece goes alongside the other, joined into a single word

parts.note: twee means pretty in a sweet or quaint way
nager is the French verb meaning to swim

explanation.surface: A pretty young person goes swimming in Paris.
explanation.definitionFit: A youth between childhood and the teens, around ten to twelve years old.

clue.text: Sounds like a vote against Arab's release?

indicators.note: Sounds like means the word is said aloud

parts.note: nay is a vote against

explanation.surface: A vote against an Arab prisoner's release.
explanation.walkthrough: An Arab is a breed of horse, and its 'release' is the noise it lets out.
explanation.definitionFit: A horse's cry; an Arab is a breed of horse.

clue.text: Discharge Maureen blocking bed after a turn

indicators.note: blocking means sitting in the middle of something
a word turned round is read in the opposite direction

parts.note: Mo is a short form of the name Maureen

explanation.surface: Maureen lies across the bed after taking a turn for the worse in hospital.
explanation.definitionFit: To release soldiers from military service, short for demobilise.

clue.text: Quick go with hairdryer perhaps while filling sarnie

indicators.note: filling means going inside

parts.note: sarnie is British slang for sandwich; a BLT is a bacon, lettuce and tomato sandwich
as can mean while

explanation.surface: Using a hairdryer while making a sandwich.
explanation.definitionFit: A short burst of hot air.

clue.text: Scoundrel meets competitor that's more bent

parts.note: a cur is a contemptible person
one who vies with others is a vier

explanation.surface: A villain faces a rival who is even more crooked.
explanation.definitionFit: Comparative of an adjective meaning curved, so having more bends.

clue.text: See 5
Woodcutter in tale died leaving store with cake

indicators.note: leaving means that a letter departs from the word

parts.note: Aldi is a discount supermarket chain
a baba is a yeast cake, often soaked in rum

explanation.surface: A woodcutter in a story drops dead outside a shop holding a cake.
explanation.definitionFit: The hero of the Arabian Nights story about forty thieves earned his living cutting wood.

clue.text: Fluid fuel, say, ultimately adding speed

indicators.note: ultimately means the final letter of each word is used

parts.note: mph is miles per hour, a measure of speed

explanation.surface: Adding fuel to a car ultimately lets it go faster.
explanation.definitionFit: A colourless bodily liquid carrying white blood cells around the body.

clue.text: Show university date around flat

indicators.note: around suggests the letters are moved about into a new order

explanation.surface: A university student takes a date to a show around their flat.
explanation.definitionFit: Faded colours or a drained person can be described as lifeless and dull.
